plan.description: Freeze prior assumptions, justification, uncertainty and multiplicity before outcomes; hash every input.
Check sources, leakage, sidedness, numeric types and plausible ranges without repairing failures.
Compute prospective normal arm sizes, detectable effect, sensitivity and per-arm attrition ceilings.
Reproduce stated counts exactly and numeric power within the frozen absolute tolerance.
Register ordinary artifacts and separate claims for coordinator-owned rigor and independent review.
